name: Rio Built-in
description: The codes Project Rio itself applies to every game -- netplay checksums, captain-select fixes, controller handling. Everything in Gecko Codes/Rio Built-in, on by default.
install:
These are the codes Rio applies on its own, so a player does not install this
bundle: it is here so the set can be rebuilt and diffed against what Rio ships.
If you do need to load it by hand, it replaces the GYQE01.ini in Rio's user
GameSettings folder -- never merged into the one already there, and never
alongside another bundle that carries the same codes, since Rio applies every
ini it reads and a doubled code overruns the gecko region and hangs the boot.
